messages:
laura: Quick sync — I'm cutting the changelog for the rc branch (rc/2026-03-21). Need a short human-friendly blurb for each entry, plus one "known issues" line. Draft PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921 :memo:

laura: Targets for this pass: 1) make the feature bullets consumer-facing (no internal jargon), 2) confirm SDK snippets match the stable tag (v1.2.0), 3) ensure the changelog generator output has frontmatter, 4) add anchor links to Dedicated autoscale and embeddings notes.

kevin: Ran the changelog-generator locally and hit: "Missing YAML frontmatter: title" for release-notes/2026-03-21.md. Looks like the template insertion didn't run in CI. I'll open a tiny patch to inject default frontmatter when empty. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4923

laura: Good catch. Please keep the frontmatter minimal: title, date, and release_type: minor. We prefer short frontmatter for the site generator.

tom: I'm updating JS snippet imports — several examples still use the old namespace. Before:
```js
import { Client } from 'redwood'
const c = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
```
After:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
```
I'll pin to @v1.2.0 tag in the snippet comments.

nina: i'll run the link-checker on the rc branch. Found two anchors missing on dedicated-config.md and embeddings.md, so release note links are 404s in staging. I'll add the anchors and a small note in embeddings.md about variable length vectors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4926

laura: For the user-facing bullets, try removing internal terms like "KV cache" and instead say "response caching" where appropriate. Also avoid internal SLA numbers; stick to "improved tail latency" language.

kevin: For the known issues blurb, proposal: "Intermittent 503 responses may occur for very large batch requests. Workaround: reduce batch size or use Dedicated pools. We're investigating." Short and customers can act on it.

laura: Yep, that's exactly the tone. Add a link to the incident runbook: /incidents/2026-03-19-large-batches.md (use anchor to the workaround section).

tom: One more: the Python snippet for streaming examples had an await missing in the loop which made the sample hang in docs playground. Fixed and added a comment about timeouts. Small diff in PR 4921.

docs-robot: CI status: docs/rc/2026-03-21 build queued. Note: link-checker job will run after unit tests.

nina: Also started a quick i18n pass: the Spanish strings for release highlights are partial. I'll add fallback English until translators finish, and mark strings with TODO.

kevin: After my frontmatter patch, generator produced the markdown; laura can you sanity-check language in the generated file before we merge? I'll hold off merging 4923 until you give the OK.

laura: Will review this afternoon. If anything blocks release window (tomorrow 15:00 PT), ping me in #release-war-room. Plan: kevin merge frontmatter fix, tom merge snippet fixes, nina merge anchors/localization, then I'll finalize the changelog and land rc.

tom: Merging my snippet commits now. If CI complains about lint I'll push a follow-up.

nina: Pushed the anchors and added the embeddings placeholder: "<embedding_length> (varies by model)" per docs guidelines.

laura: Thanks team — final ask: keep bullets under 1 line each for the UI changelog card. I'll trim during final sweep. :sparkles:
